node.title: Rate-half arbitrary received-line syndrome router
node.statement: For a linear code with parity-check column spans V_E, a received syndrome pair (s_0,s_1) has an MCA-bad finite slope gamma at agreement n-r iff some |E|<=r has s_0+gamma s_1 in V_E while s_0,s_1 are not both in V_E. Thus syndrome-pair search is exhaustive over arbitrary received lines modulo C^2. The F_7 rate-half MDS toy row has a printed pair with all seven slopes bad; no official-row lift is claimed.
node.notes: Exact N2 attack model and scope fence. The historical polynomial locator-fiber Modal census cannot test this arbitrary-line flank. The toy saturation witness is a lifting target only.
